description.value: Tino's Pizza is a family-style Italian-Canadian pizzeria that has been a Richmond staple for over 25 years, located inside the Richlea (Broadmoor) Mall between Starbucks and FreshCo. The kitchen produces fresh dough daily, hand-crafts small-batch sauces, and sources vegetables locally when available. Cyclists can eat in or grab a carry-out order from a full menu of pizzas, pastas, and salads.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 55m; rack at 56m; rack at 89m; rack at 93m.
